name: @mcpbytes/omp-memory
description: MCPBytes Memory for omp: durable decisions and opt-in, local 30-day activity history with evidence-backed recall.

apiKey.description: MCPBytes API key (console.mcpbytes.com, API keys). Without one cloud memory stays off; local history can still run.

space.description: Memory space for this project. Default: the repository's name. Set it per project in .omp/plugin-overrides.json

autoRecall.description: Recall relevant memories and due intentions for the first request of a session (charged only when a match by meaning is found)

retainNudge.description: After a run of 5 or more tool calls that saved nothing, ask the agent once whether something is worth remembering

history.description: Opt in to local, redacted 30-day activity capture. Messages and tool evidence stay on this machine; no file restoration.

historyCloudIndex.description: With history enabled, upload compact activity descriptions to MCPBytes for semantic search. Paid writes; raw evidence stays local.

historyPath.description: Local SQLite history file. Default: ~/.mcpbytes/omp-history.sqlite. Use a private directory outside monitored roots.

historyRoots.description: JSON array of local workspace roots to observe for file appearances/disappearances (metadata only). Empty: tool evidence only.
